summary: Fixed every confirmed and plausible engine finding of review A (F1-F13), the verifier's missed M1 and M2, and DOC-4, each with a test that failed on the code first and passes after, and a ledger entry under 'Review A fixes' in docs/accuracy/ledger.txt. The phone keeps every option the customer is not shown on the Options step, collapsed, with the reason, Change price, Remove price change and Details (F1, M2), and the card the quote highlights always says so (F10). The engine: batts and air sealing say the area their quantity covers, batts above the area are cut to it (F3); a quantity of 0 installs and sells nothing, and the phone refuses it (F4); two materials are not the same work (F5); install hours multiply as before the money stage (F6); an option's own removal never leaves less R than is there (F9); a tiny area never reads 0 sq ft (F12); a depth the form does not show is not priced (M1). The checker: the generator draws the same quotes whatever the engine (F7); a hidden option must be rightly hidden (F8); new kinds area_not_covered, product_not_installed, zero_work_item, ends_below_existing, wrongly_hidden, none_shown. Learning: wall actuals no longer move attic prices (F2). The dense-pack citation names one card (F13). The PDF keeps an option on one page only when it fits one (DOC-4). On the same quotes, the engine before these fixes breaks the new rules 331 times at seed 20261118 (and 637 at seed 7, 621 at seed 99999); after, every rule is 0 at all three seeds. Both golden sets are byte for byte as after the quotes stage (no option total, title, bullet, item or shown/hidden change). F11 ended as the flow stage's L23c (checker float epsilon only; R-32.7 and R-13 stay); rounding a cavity-capped R down is an owner question. Out of scope and untouched: DOC-1, DOC-2, DOC-3, the email From fallback, the Send checklist, the send route, sendChecks.ts and approvals; DOC-5, DOC-6 and DOC-7 were refuted.
